note: Public art for the board-motion prototype (the owner's decisions of 9 October 2026): the five rooms as scenes with fixed places, built around the approved rooms, and the nine characters as full-body figures drawn by a rig in a gesture for every place. The reviewed manifest and bundles are unchanged; this art is proposed for a later export revision and is adopted only through Integration.

rights.origin: Scenes: the approved rooms' groups copied element for element from the repository's original vector sources under design/source/board/, recolored by the reviewed export recipes, around new vector drawing generated for this repository by design/board-motion/scenes/. Figures: original vector drawings generated for this repository by design/board-motion/figures/, after the approved standees under design/source/crew/ and in their colors (design tokens 0.4.0). No third-party artwork, font, photograph, traced image or generated raster image.
rights.author: Visual and Motion Designer workstream, issue #87: a Claude Code session working for the game owner.
rights.license: None granted. The repository carries no distribution license.
rights.reuse: Use inside the Mothership project only. Any other use needs the game owner's decision (DSN-D06).

stylesheet.loadPolicy: Every device, with the public-board bundle, before the first match view, whatever the seat's role, state or turn. Contains public art only.

figureDrawing: Live: the prototype draws every figure from the rig (design/board-motion/figures/) and public facts, so no figure art is fetched. node design/tools/board-motion-assets.mjs --sheets <dir> writes each gesture's sheet of the nine characters, exactly what the prototype draws, for editing and review; its colors and hash are below.
